CreateSandbox.secure: Whether to encrypt all system communications of the sandbox.
CreateSandbox.allow_internet_access: Whether to allow the sandbox to access the public internet.
CreateSandbox.autoPause: Whether to automatically pause the sandbox after timeout.
CreateSandbox.autoResume: Auto-resume configuration after sandbox pause, containing an enabled (Boolean) field.
CreateSandbox.runtimeType: Sandbox runtime type; optional value: kata; only available to whitelisted users, defaults to CRIU when empty.
CreateSandbox.volumeMounts: List of NFS volumes mounted to the sandbox; each element contains name, path, subPath, and readOnly fields.
